topics.text: The hotel offers a serene, secluded setting surrounded by lush bamboo forests and natural landscapes, providing fresh air and a peaceful atmosphere. Its location on a hillside ensures breathtaking views and a tranquil escape from urban noise.
Guests consistently praised the cleanliness of rooms and common areas, noting no dust or debris, spotless floors, and meticulous attention to detail in maintaining hygiene standards.

Staff demonstrated warmth and attentiveness, with housekeepers proactively communicating arrival details and offering personalized assistance. Butler services and friendly, responsive frontline staff were frequently highlighted.

Swimming pools, saunas, KTV, and tea rooms are available. The outdoor terrace and dining areas offer panoramic views, while amenities like retro-style rooms and family-friendly features (e.g., slides) enhance guest experiences.

address: No. 1, Ganmiaowu Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, 313200, China
